summary: Adversarially verify the D.9 §1b REACHABLE/PARTIAL/CEILING verdict from the three measured numbers

reviews.binding_constraint: The zero-regression token-identity contract is numerically unsatisfiable by FP8 E4M3 on the FFN-dominated (81% of GEMM-time) GEMMs you must convert to reach 85%; finer scaling fixes dynamic range, not the ~3-bit mantissa floor or greedy near-ties.
reviews.denominator_position: Legitimate as the STATED Goal-3 anchor (989 bf16, consistent with the prior 67%=660/989), but a red herring for THIS verdict: at coverage C=0% projected MFU is pinned at the 64% vLLM baseline regardless of denominator. Flag separately that >100%-vs-989 at high coverage is FP8 beating a bf16 ruler, while FP8-native peak (1979) is ~60% — the real, distinct 700W power wall.
reviews.reasoning: M1 is solid and uncontroversial: both dtypes throttle to ~1300MHz at 700W, the 1.83x density ratio is clock-independent (verified in d9_s1b_fp8_sustained.json). M2 establishes the true engineer-from baseline is ~64% (vLLM already fuses epilogue+graphs), so FP8 is the singular lever and the projected-MFU math (verified: projected = 0.64/(1-0.454*C)) requires C~=54% of GEMM-time safe to hit 85%. M3 measured 0% safe-coverage under the strict contract, and caveat (a) is the only thing that could rescue it — so I ran the decisive confound-closer myself: FFN-only at PRODUCTION granularity (per-channel weight + per-token activation, torch._scaled_mm, same 50-prompt token-identity gate, /home/ubuntu/d9_s1b_ffn_finegrain.json) gives greedy 68.0%/sampled 66.0% -> still DECLINE, only +2pts over the crude per-tensor 66/64. Finer scaling fixes dynamic-range utilization (hence the small lift) but cannot touch E4M3's ~3-bit mantissa resolution floor or greedy near-ties, and SwiGLU down-proj activation outliers are per-channel so per-token scaling structurally leaves them; ATTN-only (19% of GEMM-time) caps at 70% even if perfectly safe, and FFN (the 81% you NEED) is both the most-needed and least-passable class. 0%-as-tested is therefore a property of the contract x E4M3 numerics, not of the crude scaling.
reviews.top_confound: A finer-still scheme tested on FFN specifically — micro-block (1x128 / 1x32 MXFP8) weight+activation scaling, or SmoothQuant/AWQ-style migrating the down-proj per-channel activation outliers into the weights. My per-channel/per-token result closes the granularity confound for standard production FP8, but micro-block scaling is the residual un-tested path; if FFN crossed ~100% token-identity there it would flip to PARTIAL/REACHABLE. Numerics prior says it won't (the mantissa floor and greedy near-ties survive any scaling), which is why this is now high not med confidence.

reviews.binding_constraint: FP8 output-identity coverage = 0% under the strict zero-regression token-identity contract (lands at the 64% vLLM baseline, not 85%).
reviews.denominator_position: 989 bf16 is a LEGITIMATE Goal-3 anchor only because it is the campaign's pre-set yardstick (prior 67%=660/989), so PARTIAL holds against it; but it is NOT a valid utilization denominator for FP8 work — the tell is the projection exceeds 100% (117% at C=1), which is denominator arbitrage (counting FP8 FLOPs against a bf16 peak). In honest per-dtype MFU, 700W caps both dtypes at ~60-65% of their OWN peak, so 85% true MFU is a hardware ceiling; the only path to "85%" is the bf16 yardstick.
reviews.reasoning: The rubric separates two axes: REACHABLE is gated "coverage permitting," CEILING is "<85% EVEN AT FULL COVERAGE." M3 measures C=0% (no layer-class stays token-identical under the strict contract), so at the contract's coverage the projection stays at M2's 64% baseline — a coverage-permit failure that lands below 85% = PARTIAL. It is NOT CEILING: the CEILING test runs at full coverage, and at C=1 vs-989 the projection is ~117%, while the FP8-numerics wall named in the CEILING parenthetical is unproven (M3 used crude per-tensor absmax; production per-channel/per-token scaling was never tested). The crossover I computed is C≈0.55 of GEMM time vs-989 (≈0.64 with 15% non-GEMM dilution, ratio 1.83x) — far above the measured 0%, and robust to ratio 1.82-2.0. The denominator-independent truth (my lens): the 700W wall pins fp16 to 65% of 989 and FP8 to ~60% of 1979, so 85% TRUE MFU is a hardware ceiling regardless of denominator — but that does not set the verdict label, because the contract (C=0%) is what blocks 85%-vs-989, not the power wall.
reviews.top_confound: M3's crude per-TENSOR absmax scaling: production per-CHANNEL weight + per-TOKEN activation scaling is materially more accurate (ATTN-only already hit 80% greedy token-identity with the crude scheme), and could lift C from 0% toward the ~55% crossover — the single thing that would flip PARTIAL to REACHABLE if re-measured. (Note: the verdict rests on the measured C=0% + rubric, NOT on this hoped-for confound.)

reviews.binding_constraint: M3 FP8-safe coverage = 0% under a strawman per-tensor quant + coarse per-class, 24-token autoregressive sequence-identity gate; with 0% coverage projected MFU stays at the M2 baseline 64%.
reviews.denominator_position: Not legitimate as a Goal-3 claim: >=85%-vs-989-bf16 is FP8 hardware beating a bf16 yardstick. The only defensible MFU-vs-989 wall is the bf16 GEMM power ceiling (~65%); above it you have switched formats, so the honest denominator is FP8-native 1979, against which the GEMM is power-capped at ~60% and 85% is a CEILING.
reviews.reasoning: I read the three harness sources, not just the summary. M1 (45-60s sustained loop, power confirmed ~690-704W at the 700W cap, clock-normalized 1.83x ratio matching the 1.85x burst) and M2 (vLLM, prefix-cache OFF + chunked-prefill OFF confirmed in source AND log, distinct prompts via _CALL counter defeating the >100% KV-hit bug, prefill isolated from decode) are trustworthy and mutually coherent: M2's 64% lands exactly at M1's fp16 GEMM ceiling of 65%, so the ~64% engineer-from baseline and the bf16-power-wall framing hold. M3's 0% is a REAL output but an UNTRUSTWORTHY measure of achievable coverage: it uses the crudest per-tensor absmax for both weight and activation (lines 33-38), credits coverage only at whole-FFN/whole-ATTN granularity so one bad layer poisons a class (ATTN-only is already 80% greedy-identical), and operationalizes "token-identical" as 24-step autoregressive greedy-sequence identity (line 86) where a single benign near-tie flip cascades to a full DECLINE. Because the coverage input is artifact-inflated low and the only path above ~65%-vs-989 is a denominator switch to FP8 that is itself power-capped at ~60% of native peak, this is neither clean REACHABLE (coverage input is not credibly measured) nor clean CEILING (the cited 0% is a strawman, not a numerics wall). Hence PARTIAL.
reviews.top_confound: M3's quant scheme and decision granularity: re-running with production FP8 (per-channel weight + per-token activation) and a per-layer (not per-class) safe-set search scored on single-forward per-GEMM output token-identity (not 24-step sequence identity) would likely move coverage off 0%; a non-trivial C flips the verdict toward REACHABLE-vs-989, while a still-0% result would reclassify the wall as contract-induced (the strict no-tolerance gate, not the hardware).

reviews.binding_constraint: The zero-regression (strict token-identity) contract, not hardware: it forces FP8-safe coverage to 0% of GEMM time on Mistral-7B, so projected MFU stays at the 64% bf16 power wall.
reviews.denominator_position: NOT legitimate. >=85%-vs-989-bf16 while running FP8 GEMMs is denominator arbitrage (FP8 silicon beating a bf16 yardstick, projecting >100%); an honest FP8 MFU must use the 1979 FP8-native peak, against which the GEMM is ~60% power-capped — i.e. a real 700W CEILING that the 989 framing hides.
reviews.reasoning: M1 confirms FP8 is genuine silicon: 1168-1204 TFLOPS sustained, 1.82-1.84x over fp16, clock-independent at the ~1300 MHz 700W wall — a real 1.83x throughput lever. M2 shows vLLM prefill already at ~64% (the bf16 GEMM ceiling), so the 64->85 gap is entirely the bf16 power wall and FP8 is the only lever. But M3, under the explicitly-mandated strict KL=0 / token-identity gate, finds NO layer-class stays output-identical (best is ATTN-only 80% greedy, and ATTN is only 19% of GEMM-time per the file's weights; FFN at 66% is 81% of GEMM-time), giving 0% safe coverage -> projected MFU = 64%, FP8 never engages. This is PARTIAL (lands 64% < 85%, constraint named) and NOT CEILING: against the rubric's anchor 989 denominator, FULL FP8 coverage would clear 85% (118-122%), so the blocker is coverage=0 from the contract, not a hardware ceiling — though against the correct 1979 FP8-native denominator it would be a ~60% FLOP/J CEILING. Serving-pragmatist honest deliverable: strict KL=0 kills FP8 today (0 tokens/s win), but the 0% is almost certainly understated by the crudest-possible per-tensor absmax scaling (caveat a) and the brutal token-identity gate that counts benign greedy-tie flips as regressions (caveat b) — so the right move is to surface the bounded-quality tradeoff to the principal (re-run with production per-channel/per-token scaling and propose a bounded-KL gate) rather than declare FP8 dead.
reviews.top_confound: FP8 scaling granularity (caveat a): M3 used per-tensor absmax for both weight and activation, the crudest scheme. Re-running with production per-channel weight + per-token activation scales would materially raise coverage; if FFN (81% of GEMM-time) crosses the identity gate, harvestable coverage flips from 0% to large and the serving verdict flips from dead to a real ~1.8x win.

critique.binding_constraint_one_line: The strict zero-regression token-identity CONTRACT (not hardware) forces FP8-safe coverage to ~0% of GEMM-time on Mistral-7B, so projected MFU stays at the M2 vLLM baseline (~64% of 989 bf16); against the fixed 989 anchor the hardware itself clears 85% (FP8 sustains 118-122%), so the wall is contract/coverage, not a FLOP/J or numerics ceiling.
critique.single_next_measurement: Re-score coverage under the contract's LITERAL gate — single forward-pass per-GEMM output token-identity ("full-forward output") with a per-LAYER (not per-class) safe-set search — instead of the strictly-harder 24-token autoregressive sequence-identity gate that compounds benign greedy near-tie flips and likely manufactures DECLINEs. This is the only untested path: still-0% locks PARTIAL@64% and hardens the wall as contract-induced; a harvestable subset gives PARTIAL>64%; ≥~54% coverage would flip to REACHABLE-vs-989 (unlikely given FFN-class decline). NOTE: finer FP8 scaling is NOT the next measurement — it is already done (see flags).
critique.flags: DECISIVE UNREAD EVIDENCE: /home/ubuntu/d9_s1b_ffn_finegrain.json (+ .py), written 18:50 on 2026-05-29 AFTER the M1/M2/M3 packet, already MEASURES the confound 3 of 4 reviewers cite as un-tested. Production per-CHANNEL weight + per-TOKEN activation FP8 on the FFN class (81% of GEMM-time, the class that MUST be safe to reach 85%) moved coverage only 66%->68% greedy / 64%->66% sampled — still DECLINE, +2pp, far from the 100% gate. So caveat (a) / the granularity confound is EMPIRICALLY CLOSED, not open; finer scaling does not need to be run first. OVER-CLAIMS: Reviewers 2,3,4 reach the correct floor but present granularity as a live route to REACHABLE — it is dead (R2 is cleanest, rests on measured C=0% not the hope). Reviewer 1 (CEILING): its numerics prior is now confirmed by the +2pp, but that supports "coverage stays ~0," NOT "hardware ceiling"; CEILING is only valid against the 1979 FP8-native denominator, which the task explicitly rejects in favor of the 989 bf16 anchor — so R1 mislabels a contract/coverage wall as a hardware wall and over-claims confidence. GAP NOT YET CLOSED (R3 alone flags it): the per-LAYER safe-set search scored on single-forward per-GEMM identity vs the 24-step autoregressive sequence-identity gate actually used (caveat b) — this is the real residual, and it is the next measurement. The denominator (caveat c) IS the PARTIAL/CEILING fork and should be stated explicitly: vs 989 bf16 (task anchor) -> coverage-limited -> PARTIAL; vs 1979 FP8-native -> CEILING. Floor on current evidence is PARTIAL@64%.
